# Riverbend Nonprofit Network theory of change: story for Funders

As of 2026-09-30.

## What this audience needs

Evidence that members are stronger and that residents are better served.

Reached through: annual report, grant report.

## Numbers for this audience

| Indicator | Latest | Status | How to describe it |
|-----------|--------|--------|--------------------|
| Residents served by members | 62000 residents (estimate, on 2026-09-30) | On track | a contribution, not attributable to the work alone |
| Member organizations the network reached | 84 member organizations (on 2026-09-30) | On track | attributable to the work |
| Back-office share of operating budget | 20.8 percent (on 2026-09-30) | On track | a contribution, not attributable to the work alone |
| Leadership practice maturity | Emerging (on 2026-09-30) | On track | a contribution, not attributable to the work alone |

Caveats that go with these numbers:

- Reflects members' reported reach; Riverbend Nonprofit Network cannot attribute resident outcomes to its own work.
- Residents who use several members are counted more than once.
- Not equal to the sum of the program-area counts, which double count members in more than one program.
- Self-reported by members; other cost changes can also move the figure.
- Rated by coaches and members, so it reflects self-assessment as well as observed practice.

## Outcomes for this audience

| Outcome | Status |
|---------|--------|
| Residents get timely, good-quality services from local nonprofits | At risk |
| Member nonprofits run strong, well-managed organizations | Not started |

## Stories

### A director borrows another member's hiring process

_2026-08-12_

A new executive director of a small member called a peer from the same cohort about a hiring problem and adopted the peer's interview process within a week.

> I would have spent a month on that alone.

Why it was chosen: Shows the cohort format working for a first-time director.

## Themes in these stories

| Theme | Stories |
|-------|---------|
| Members helping each other | 1 |

## For the writer

- Use the numbers as given; each is the latest value in the status snapshot above.
- Say "contributed to" for any figure marked as a contribution.
- Quote only the words shown here, and do not add a name.
